exposure: Multiphase quality improvement effort to decrease opioid prescribing
Counseling regarding expectations for pain, typical need for opioids, and importance of multimodal nonopioid analgesic use
Shared decision-making to determine the number of opioids prescribed
outcome: Mean number of opioid tablets prescribed on discharge
Opioid refill rate within 30 days of discharge
Rates of nonopioid analgesic prescriptions on discharge
finding: Implementation of a multiphase quality improvement protocol to decrease opioid prescribing, combined with iterative review of discharge data, resulted in a significant decrease in the number of opioid tablets prescribed after cesarean delivery.
